svg.text: Teryx OS wiring, sheet 'winch'. Made from config/wiring.yaml by `python -m teryx wiring`. Don't edit this file.
Labels: wire id, size, fuse (if the wire has its own), and anything in between. Faded = optional. Hover for notes. Full table: docs/wiring/README.md

g.title: WN01: BAT12.pos -> BRK_WINCH.in - Cable that came with the winch
WN06: WINCH_SOL.REMOTE -> WINCH_REMOTE.PLUG - XBull remote stays as a backup
WN10: RELAYS.NO4 -> WINCH_SOL.COIL_IN - winch.in. Never the motor current through the relay board
WN11: RELAYS.NO5 -> WINCH_SOL.COIL_OUT - winch.out, interlocked with in
WN12: RELAYS.NO6 -> WINCH_ISO.coil_pos - winch.isolator, only while armed
BAT12: 12 V aux battery - Kept after the conversion. Charged by the DC-DC
WINCH_ISO: Winch isolator contactor - Only on while the winch is armed on the dash (relay 6)

RELAYS: 8-ch relay board - Mechanical 5 V relays with opto and JD-VCC jumper (AliExpress cart). The solid state G3MB-202P board Sam has is AC only and won't turn off on 12 V DC. JD-VCC jumper off, coils on 5 V, inputs from 3.3 V
HSW_WINCH: Hidden winch switch (at the winch) - Momentary (ON)-OFF-(ON)
HSW_CAB: Hidden winch switch (in the cab) - Momentary (ON)-OFF-(ON)

FB: Blade fuse block - 12 fuses in use. Small loads that can go out together share a fuse (front bars in pairs, trailer tail + stop, interior bar + accessory). All four front bars are NOT on one fuse, so one fault can't black out the front at night. The winch, control box power, key, power hold and each actuator keep their own. A 20-way leaves 8 spares

svg.text: WN10 0.5 mm² 3 A via 3 A diode (1N5408)
